Name: (FF) Wall-Mounted Shelves
Author: KaliRivera
Description:
[color=#ff0000]1.1 Update[/color]: Added various 1-Slot shelves, including Shelf Sections to add the ability to create custom lengths of shelves. Adjusted the layering so the shelves can be placed above the kitchen. 

Ever since the 1.6 update came out, haven't you wanted a way to display all of your cute & colorful artisan goods? Me too, so I added some shelves!

There are currently 9 styles to choose from to match the vanilla furniture sets:
[list]
[*]Oak
[*]Walnut
[*]Birch
[*]Mahogany
[*]Gray
[*]Retro
[*]Junimo
[*]Wizard
[*]Joja
[/list]Each style is available in 1-slot, 2-slot, and 3-slot. More sizes and styles may be included in future updates!

As of now these are only available in the Furniture Catalogue, and this mod requires Furniture Framework to work.

[color=#ffd966]If you'd like to be able to place shelves in the hallways, on the Spouse Room beam, etc., please check out my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27020]Hallway Fix[/url]! [/color]
